scope: Constitutional branches, core federal departments, first-level supporting institutions, selected independent federal bodies and judiciary aggregates.
non_goals: Exhaustive subordinate agencies and field offices
Exhaustive State institutions in all 50 States; tribal, territorial and local office inventories (except explicitly documented pilot State local-government classes)
Current officeholders, personnel rosters or partisan appointments
Legal conclusions about disputed executive control of independent agencies
Browser visualization code or publication server implementation
Comprehensive DHS/Department of Education functional powers, active subdelegations, verified appropriations and agency-specific program grant authority.

standards.name: FEAF v2
standards.usage: Reference-model family mapping only; no claim that ARFI classifications are official FEAF BRM subcategories

standards.name: ArchiMate
standards.usage: Conceptual interoperability target; no normative conformance claimed

standards.name: UAF/DoDAF
standards.usage: Future specialist viewpoints, not used as authoritative graph syntax

source_policy: Official government primary and agency material; public source IDs, date and bounded confidence. Sources document roles, not legal advice.

publication_contract.immutable_snapshot: Website SHOULD pin Git commit or release tag
publication_contract.comments: Public comments bind element IDs and immutable snapshot commit
publication_contract.storage: Architecture repository is source of truth; website is renderer and discussion host.

constitutional_extension.scope: Original Constitution, 27 ratified Amendments, selected clause and normative-effect decomposition. Interpretive doctrine is a separate future catalog.
constitutional_extension.publication_note: Source-linked original text does not imply operative effect for superseded provisions.

article_i_extension.scope: All original Article I clauses, text-bound conditions and exceptions, selected amendment overlays, congressional power-to-constraint and federal capability mappings; no agency delegation claimed.
article_i_extension.publication_note: Do not infer current legal effect from historic clauses or equate functional alignment with authority to execute.

article_ii_extension.scope: Original Article II numbered clauses, analytic decomposition of unnumbered Section 3, Section 4 removal, textual limitations, ratified amendment overlays and capability alignments.
article_ii_extension.publication_note: Function segments of Section 3 are ARFI analysis units, NOT numbered constitutional clauses. No case-law or statutory delegation is implied.

article_iii_extension.scope: Judicial vesting, good-behavior tenure and compensation, lower-court creation, nine textual jurisdiction categories, original and appellate jurisdiction, criminal jury/venue, treason and congressional punishment limits.
article_iii_extension.publication_note: Section 1 analytical segments are not numbered constitutional clauses; Article I tribunals are not Article III courts, and jurisdictional categories are not self-executing grants to all courts.

federalism_extension.scope: Articles IV and VI, Amendments X, XI, XIV, with Thirteenth and Twenty-Sixth Amendment historical/temporal overlays. Separate state sovereignty and federal institutions; differentiate rights of citizens and persons.
federalism_extension.publication_note: No federal agency may claim powers from functional alignments; superseded fugitive-service clause has no operative rights, duties, or authority; broad immunity/incorporation/anti-commandeering doctrines require judicial case law.

amendment_decomposition_extension.scope: All 27 ratified amendments with non-numbered source segments, legal-effect chronology (ratification, delayed effect, repeal, transition), amended original text and cross-Article functional traceability.
amendment_decomposition_extension.publication_note: Analytic segments are never constitutional clauses. Amendment XVIII is repealed; historic conditions and grandfather rules are not current powers. Case-law, statutory delegations and contested application are separate future catalogs.

judicial_precedent_extension.source_text_basis: Eight additional official United States Reports government locators plus existing official United States Reports, Court opinion PDFs and labeled government explanatory materials
judicial_precedent_extension.scope: Holding-level judicial interpretations across Articles I–VI and Amendments II/X/XI/XIV. Explicit Supreme Court case and treatment evidence distinct from ratified constitutional source text, contested opinion-part interpretations, statutory delegations or unsupported current-citator claims.
judicial_precedent_extension.citation_integrity: Never infer negative precedent history from absent citation edges; citator coverage is non-exhaustive and all statuses are explicitly provisional.
judicial_precedent_extension.publication_note: No opinion text copyrighted reproduction. No website rendering engine or API changes.

state_institutional_extension.institutional_coverage: Independent, source-located starter architecture for Virginia and Nebraska; 48 State institutional models remain deliberately unpopulated, not identical copies.
state_institutional_extension.scope: Non-federal constitutional State governments, first-pass Virginia and Nebraska independent institutional authorities, State-to-federal constitutional ceilings, original State text separately from later Supreme Court limits.
state_institutional_extension.publication_note: Constitutional institutional model remains separately source-indexed. Two pilot appellate courts now have distinct bounded statutory enabling-authority overlays in model/state/statutory-*.json; no other State office or agency power is inferred. The District of Columbia remains non-State.

state_statutory_extension.scope: First statute-proven authority trails for Virginia and Nebraska Court of Appeals, including section-specific jurisdictional boundaries. No complete State agency rosters or court jurisdiction coverage.
state_statutory_extension.publication_note: Research data only. Statutory court establishment differs from jurisdiction; no new governmental powers, appropriations, live website rendering, or professional citator verification inferred.

articles_iv_vii_completion_extension.publication_note: Completes original-text analysis for Articles IV-VII using existing IV/VI federalism units, distinct unnumbered Article V/VII analytical spans, and indexed current/expired limitations. Does not certify post-1787 legal doctrine, enact statutes, convene Article V conventions or render website views.

federal_statutory_extension.source_scope: Official U.S. Code excerpts for DHS, Department of Education, and a separate GEPA constraint with organizational, delegated function, rights-protection and federalism limits.
federal_statutory_extension.publication_note: No verified funding, budget, actual delegation instrument, program-level statute, judicial citator completeness, independently verified operational effect or website rendering. Code groups remain distinct from enacted Public Law session-history.

focused_projection_extension.scope_constraints: Filters never create legal authorities or omit historical legal-effect metadata from canonical models.
focused_projection_extension.cross_domain_policy: Explicit typed relationships only; no First Amendment/DoD relationship inferred from matching text.

federal_institutional_census_extension.identity_policy: ARFI IDs are internal stable aliases; no federal source entity identifiers are invented.
federal_institutional_census_extension.organizational_policy: Structural membership does not assert operational command or general agency power.
federal_institutional_census_extension.adl_policy: ADL-0 means source-identified, not complete or reviewed; no blanket ADL-1 assigned.
federal_institutional_census_extension.next_stage: Complete source-edition census, verified first-level organizational links, then statutory authority mapping.
